name: pi-sdk-web
description: Browser Web access for Pi (AI coding agent) via the Pi SDK - standalone module, zero modification to Pi itself

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node -e "require('node:fs').cpSync('../static', 'dist/static', { recursive: true }); require('node:fs').mkdirSync('dist/pi-bin', { recursive: true }); require('node:fs').chmodSync('dist/cli.js', 0o755); require('node:fs').renameSync('dist/pii-cli.js', 'dist/pi-bin/pii-cli.js'); require('node:fs').chmodSync('dist/pi-bin/pii-cli.js', 0o755); require('node:fs').cpSync('../pii/pii', 'dist/pi-bin/pii'); require('node:fs').cpSync('../server', 'dist/pi-bin/server', { recursive: true, filter: (s) => !s.includes('__pycache__') })"

author: maxdai
